params.model: dS = mu S dt + sigma S dW (drift first); Euler step S_{i+1} = S_i (1 + mu dt + sigma dW_i); exact S_T = S0 exp((mu - 1/2 sigma^2) T + sigma W_T)

p1_case.note: the owner's P1 as posed: mu = 0, sigma = 0.4, T = 1

drag.note: log of the mean minus the mean of the log: the lognormal's mean-vs-median gap, -1/2 sigma^2 T
log of the mean minus the mean of the log: the lognormal's mean-vs-median gap, -1/2 sigma^2 T

gap_log.note: log S^Euler_T - log S^exact_T on the same normals; leading term -1/2 sigma^2 (Sum (dW)^2 - T), sd 1/2 sigma^2 T sqrt(2/n)

resid_lead.note: gap_log minus its leading term: 1/3 sigma^3 Sum (dW)^3 - mu sigma dt W_T - 1/2 mu^2 T dt - 1/4 sigma^4 Sum (dW)^4 + ...: order 1/n

r_qv.note: log S^Euler_T - log S_0 - Sum [x_i - 1/2 x_i^2], x_i = mu dt + sigma dW_i: Taylor's third order and beyond along the Euler path, order 1/n

cubic.note: 1/3 Sum x_i^3: the signed cubes cancel, sd ~ sigma^3 sqrt(15) T^(3/2) / (3 n)

r_3.note: fourth order and beyond: mean -3/4 sigma^4 T dt + ..., order 1/n

realised_vol.note: sqrt(Sum r_i^2 / T), r_i the Euler path's log-return per step; demeaned: sd(r_i) sqrt(n/T)

realised_vol_bug.note: on the sigma Z dt path the noise per step is sigma dt Z and the drift mu dt is the same size, so sqrt(Sum r_i^2 / T) = sqrt(sigma^2 + mu^2) sqrt(dt) and the demeaned sd(r_i) sqrt(n/T) = sigma sqrt(dt): too small by 1/sqrt(dt) = sqrt n either way

log_bug.note: log(S^bug_T / S_0): its spread across paths collapses by the same sqrt(dt)
